name: Stale Oracle Data
threat_model: A borrower exploits a lending protocol that accepts an old, invalid, or otherwise unsuitable external price report to overstate collateral value.
assumptions: The feed follows the Chainlink-style round-data interface used by the example.
The test uses deterministic mock feeds; it does not prove the quality or availability of a live feed.
The safe example applies configured freshness, decimal, round, sequencer, and deviation checks.
invariant: Collateral valuation uses only a valid, current price within the configured oracle policy.

detector_expectations.expectation: oracle freshness, feed semantics, and economic validity require semantic checks
